evals.prompt: I'm starting a new Next.js app with a Postgres backend and Vercel deployment. It'll have an API layer, maybe 20-30 source files to start. How should I organize my docs?
evals.expected_output: Recommends medium project template, suggests CLAUDE.md + docs/ with reference/ and possibly plans/. Explains what goes in CLAUDE.md vs extracted docs.
assertions: Recommends medium project template (not small or large)
Explains what belongs in CLAUDE.md vs extracted docs

evals.prompt: My CLAUDE.md is 800 lines long and keeps growing. It has the full API endpoint table (40 endpoints), deployment procedures, a changelog, and architecture notes all in one file. Help me slim it down.
evals.expected_output: Identifies what to extract (API table → reference/, deploy procedures → runbooks/, changelog → product/). Provides a slimmed CLAUDE.md outline under 250 lines with a doc index table.
assertions: Identifies extractable sections (API, deploy, changelog, schema)
Proposes target locations for each extraction
Slimmed CLAUDE.md includes documentation index table

evals.prompt: I have 15 markdown files all dumped in a flat docs/ folder. Some are design specs from months ago, some are current API docs, there's a deploy guide, two research notes, and a few files I'm not sure are still relevant. Help me reorganize this mess.
evals.expected_output: Classifies each doc by audience + freshness, proposes directory structure, provides migration steps, suggests archiving outdated docs.
